Workshop services

Glass and aluminum facades in Riyadh

We design and install glass facades for residential and commercial buildings in Riyadh. Working with the project engineer, we select curtain walls, spider glazing or aluminum cladding to suit the building’s height, design and sun exposure.

Materials and finish

Specifications and options

What should I send for a shopfront survey?

Share the approximate facade width and height and a photo showing the entrance and glazing limits. An elevation drawing helps distinguish fixed panels from openings. If the entrance is part of the facade, review aluminum entrance doors alongside the glazing system.

  • Facade details coordinated with the architecture.
  • Thermal insulation to help reduce energy use.
  • Systems designed for wind and rain.
  • Break- and scratch-resistant glass options.
  • Self-cleaning glass options for easier maintenance.
  • Custom framing and panel layouts.
From survey to installation

How we work

  1. 01

    Building review

    We study the architectural drawings and facade openings.

  2. 02

    Engineering design

    We coordinate the system and fixing details with the project engineer.

  3. 03

    Frame and glass preparation

    We fabricate the framing and prepare the measured panels.

  4. 04

    Specialist installation

    The team installs the framing and glazing with equipment suited to the facade.
